register_student_campus() uses case-insensitive regex match on name only — if user submits an existing campus with different code, no code auto-assigned (returns None). Fine, but consider surfacing existing campus back to client so UI can display code.

PUT /api/profile response shape now includes optional `campus` key — good. StudentDashboard.saveProfile should append this to local campuses list so subsequent renders show the new campus in the dropdown without a page reload (verify UX).
campus counter key 'student-campus-code' is monotonic; once you delete a student-registered campus the code is not reused. Acceptable, but code sequence gaps will appear. Document this expectation.
